newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen parliament wants local labour in oil sector.
newsitem.headline: Yemen parliament wants local labour in oil sector.

text.p: Yemen's parliament has called on the government to draw up a timetable to increase the percentage of nationals working in the oil sector, the official al-Thawra newspaper said on Friday.

Parliament urged the government "to set up a clear and precise timetable to 'Yemenise' different jobs and specialities for all oil agreements reached with different oil companies in Yemen and to present the timetable to parliament for approval," the paper said.
Parliament must approve all oil deals signed by the government.
In July, an official at the oil and mineral resources ministry said it was in a labour dispute with private U.S. oil firm Hunt Oil over the employment of foreign rather than Yemeni workers.
